title: Cmd
description: design/developers/plugin_model.md §3 (Cmd object): one entry of a NodeDef's `cmds.sends`/`cmds.accepts` (nodedef.schema.json). Restructured from iox-vscode-plugin's commands.schema.json, which lacks `native`, `format`, and (via parameter.schema.json) `optional`/`init`/`desc` on parameters entirely -- ioxplugin's Command dialect is strictly poorer than the real Cmd/Parameter shape, so those fields are added here. Neither `native` nor `name` is required here, even though neither has an explicit '(Optional)' marker in the spec's own table: §3's worked Profile example includes `native` on only one of three sibling commands (`{"id": "DISCOVER", "native": "false", ...}` vs `{"id": "QUERYALL", "name": "Query All"}` with no `native`), and src/nucore/profile.py reads both via `cdict.get(...)` -- see schemas/README.md's leniency-policy note. Per the spec, `native` is typed as the STRING "true"/"false", not a JSON boolean.

native.description: String, not boolean, per the spec's own worked example (`"native": "false"`).

format.description: How this command is displayed in the program editor -- see plugin_model.md §4 (Formatting in Programs and Scenes).
